objects.name: Analytic 2128
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a scripting interpreter process iterating through Industrial Control System (ICS) data sources and writing output to a local file or piping to a network socket, by a User Identifier (UID) not associated with documented automation scripts. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
